title: LDI: forced flows and liquidity provision

sources.sourceRole: Primary publication; account may be retrospective or interested-party

documentedClaim: Transaction-level research attributes gilt selling pressure to repo and derivative exposures and describes compensation for liquidity provision.
inferredMechanism: Collateral constraints can force price-insensitive sales when intermediary capacity is scarce.
counterevidence: A crisis study is retrospective; access to its transaction-level dataset is not established for this lab.
transferRequirements: Require pre-event exposure proxies, financing survival and executable prices; one crisis cannot establish repeatable net returns.
outcomeBoundary: Public narrative already inspected; described cases are discovery examples, never untouched confirmation. No experimental market outcome dataset opened.
